We have developed a BDI-based agent-oriented software engineering methodology that extends existing OO modelling techniques and is based on a formal semantics.

the BDI paradigm can be used to build a modelling technique that extends existing OO models, and that the resulting models are suitable for use in a methodology for the construction of systems of BDI agents.

the development of an approach to the design, analysis, and implementation of agent-based systems that is based upon the BDI agent model, but is sufficiently well-understood and mature to be usable by practising software analysts and engineers.
the development and application of a methodology and modelling technique that supports the construction of large-scale systems based upon the BDI agent paradigm, using an OO approach.
